our_interpretation: The plain reading is that current AI application revenue falls far short of the annual revenue required by the investment models discussed in the post.
The surrounding analysis explicitly uses calendar-2026 annual revenue estimates. The target is those estimates as understood at publication, not a claim that final 2026 revenue was already reported.
Use the application layer identified in the surrounding passage. Do not add chip sales and cloud sales to application revenue without addressing double counting.
A large present shortfall does not establish that infrastructure investment can never earn a return. No precise percentage defines 'same universe of scale'.
criteria.support_condition: An independently documented, sufficiently complete estimate of calendar-2026 AI application revenue is substantially below a comparable annual revenue requirement, with the gap remaining large under reasonable measurement and model assumptions.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A comparable industry revenue estimate is already close to or above the relevant annual requirement, so that the claimed large shortfall does not hold.
